intro.text: A Voidspren who worked with Venli to bring about the Everstorm, known to the Fused as the Envoy.

items.text: Ulim had a past with the Herald Nale, though they were not friends, and fell silent when Nale told him to be quiet.

Having escaped Braize, Ulim came to Venli in a gemstone. He persuaded her to work with him to bring back her people's gods, and the pair secretly captured stormspren to discover stormform; Venli took the credit, but Ulim did most of the work.

Once the Everstorm came, Ulim showed himself to the surviving listeners and took a leading role. He sent them to find Eshonai's body for her Shards and taught Venli and others how to prepare to be taken by Fused souls.

appearance.text: A small red figure in human form, with odd eyes and long hair that ripples as if in wind. He moves as rolling lightning and can make himself invisible.

personality.text: Arrogant and spiteful, with human mannerisms, he mocks the listeners and Venli's grief, but is deferential and fearful before the Fused.
